In this video we cover:
Why Singtel Is Selling Stake in Airtel | Airtel's Journey & Future Strategy
Singapore's Singtel is selling a $1.5 billion stake in Bharti Airtel, reducing its holding to 28.3%. This move is part of its capital strategy, not an exit. We’ll explore Airtel’s journey since Jio’s 2016 disruption, its recovery through premiumisation and Project Leap, and deep dive into its FY25 Q4 results—covering revenue growth, ARPU trends, 5G rollout, capex cuts, and future tariff hikes.
